title: Baked Snapper Pastitsio
description: A Mediterranean twist on the classic Greek pasta dish, featuring fresh snapper as the star ingredient.

ingredients.name: Greek pasta (such as penne or rigatoni)

instructions: Cook the Greek pasta al dente according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the fish stock over medium heat.
Add the vibrant tomato sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
Season the snapper fillet with salt and pepper.
Place the snapper fillet in a baking dish and spoon the tomato sauce over the top.
Sprinkle the crispy panko breadcrumbs over the top of the snapper.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the snapper is cooked through.
Serve the baked snapper with the cooked Greek pasta and tomato sauce.
Garnish with chopped parsley or dill, if desired.
